verdict.rationale: An official CLI is documented (Wally releases), and the docs say the same CLI runs a small model on your own machine, offline and without an account. A single command 'points a tool at a model and starts it', with `--cloud` passed as an opencode flag. That implies terminal-based model interaction, but no doc explicitly describes an interactive chat REPL. Hands-on reports on the rcli terminal tool are mixed: one user called it a fun working demo with loading bugs, while another hit a segfault, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an interactive terminal chat command or session (e.g. multi-turn REPL usage), and reliable independent corroboration that the CLI chat works across installs.
